title: P4 Capture integration
human_intent: Make voice/text Capture available while moving through Prometeo pages, keep raw intent durable, allow consecutive recordings, produce scoped Patents for fresh chats, and metabolize recent exact context + historical summary without creating a second authority system.
already_decided: Do not rebuild another global puck/shell as authority.
Capture is human-intent input; it does not become Current/Human Accepted/Served merely by existing.
Context Foundry remains context authority; Supabase is private transport/status, not product truth.
Patent transport binds exact Capture revisions plus repository authority bindings.
The frozen P4 100-point plan already exists; do not regenerate it every turn.
ref_convention: Each read ref explicitly names its branch. Never silently read a candidate-only path from main.
high_value_targets: Finish the candidate runtime rather than add planning artifacts.
Prove consecutive Capture while navigation continues.
Prove explicit export proposal -> human approval -> export receipt -> Patent v2.
Prove fresh-agent Patent execution can reincarnate repository authority without chat history.
Reach a real desktop canary and then the unavoidable Android microphone/human acceptance boundary.
known_failures: V2/V3 global shell injectors competed and caused served drift.
A visible puck can exist while not participating correctly in V53 ownership.
Auto-provisioning remote workspaces from arbitrary bearer material is not acceptable.
Private transcripts must not become publicly enumerable context.
Repeated verification without new product delta is specifically discouraged.
